producer_report.summary: The decisions page now lists a proposal only if no decision names it and its rung is above the raising role's limit. A role with no recorded definition counts as above the limit. With none left, the page shows one line, 'Nothing waiting for you'. Snapshot gained a `decided` set, and render() does the filtering, so the rule holds for any Snapshot. The missing-branch message is unchanged. I added three tests (empty case, one card, and a records-branch test with Approved and Rejected decisions) and updated two existing tests. I also updated the module doc and added a CHANGELOG line. I did not find why the decided items still showed on 3 Nov; see open_issues.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in xtask/src/decisions.rs builds a Snapshot with three proposals (one with an Approved WorkDecision, one with a Rejected WorkDecision, one raised by a role whose limit covers its rung) and asserts render() contains 'Nothing waiting for you', contains no '<article', and has no 'N waiting' heading. Run: cargo test -p xtask decisions.
criteria_check.evidence:
approved_rejected_and_within_limit_proposals_leave_nothing_waiting passes. It builds a Snapshot with a decided set naming two proposals and one within-limit proposal, then asserts the empty line, no
'. The Snapshot holds decided ids, not WorkDecision records, so Approved/Rejected are not distinguished there.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test builds a records branch (or Snapshot) with one open proposal above the raising role's limit and asserts render() shows exactly one '<article' card and the heading '1 waiting'. Run: cargo test -p xtask decisions.

A test through the records branch path (locate() on a temp git repo with RecordsWriter) covers an approved decision whose job is set, confirming the approved proposal is not listed. Run: cargo test -p xtask decisions.
criteria_check.evidence: an_approved_decision_on_the_records_branch_hides_its_proposal passes. It writes an Approved{job} and a Rejected decision plus three proposals, and locate() then shows only the open one.

criteria_check.criterion: The empty state is a single line reading 'Nothing waiting for you' in xtask/src/decisions.rs render(), replacing the old 'No proposals waiting' section; the missing-records-branch message stays distinct.
criteria_check.evidence:
render() now emits

Nothing waiting for you

. The Missing branch is unchanged ('No proposals listed'), and its test still passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing tests in xtask/src/decisions.rs that conflicted with the new rule are updated, and the module doc comment states that only open, above-limit proposals are listed.
criteria_check.evidence: The empty-branch test now asserts the new wording. The records-branch listing test now gives the steward an Implementation limit, so its proposals are above it. The Snapshot literal gained the decided field. The module doc was rewritten.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets pass and cargo fmt --check is clean.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran only the targeted xtask decisions tests, the policy test and cargo fmt --all.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has one line describing the decisions page fix.

open_issues: Root cause not confirmed. This working copy has no records, so I could not inspect the branch the published page was built from. The reader already dropped proposals named by a decision. Candidates: a stale or unfetched records branch at build time, or decision records the reader could not parse (they would only show under 'Not shown', and the proposal would stay listed). The pages workflow fetches with --depth=1 and only warns if the fetch fails. I did not edit .github/. The owner should check the deployed page's footer tip against the current athena/records tip.
mistakes: I could not find the reason the approved and rejected items still showed on 3 Nov, so the root cause is not confirmed.
learnings: may_change(limit, rung) is true only when rung >= DesignDecisions and rung >= limit; a smaller Ladder value is a higher rung.
The old read_snapshot already dropped decided proposals. The page rendering also relied on that single filter, with no rule inside render().
desires: Read access to the published records branch, to see why the approved and rejected items still showed on 3 Nov.
